assertions.text: Clearly states that generated files are overwritten on regeneration
assertions.evidence: States 'your edits will not survive. BackendGenerator.generate() overwrites everything every time. Each call replaces all three output files (main_api.py, pydantic_classes.py, sql_alchemy.py) entirely.'

assertions.text: Recommends creating separate extension/wrapper files that import from generated code
assertions.evidence: Option A recommends a 'wrapper script that mounts the generated app' in a separate file (app.py) that imports the generated FastAPI app, plus custom_queries.py importing from sql_alchemy. 'keep your custom logic in separate files... never in the generated file.'

assertions.text: Shows a concrete code example of the extension pattern (importing from main_api or generated app)
assertions.evidence: Concrete example: 'from main_api import app' followed by '@app.get("/custom/stats")' and '@app.post("/custom/books/validated")' route definitions in app.py.

assertions.text: Does NOT recommend editing main_api.py directly as the primary approach
assertions.evidence: Explicitly advises against it: 'Don't touch main_api.py' and 'Don't edit main_api.py directly as your workflow — it's overwritten on every generate().' Primary approaches are the wrapper (A) and model-based (B) patterns.
